mapper.select: SELECT i.*, u.username, ( CASE WHEN i.category = #{category} THEN 50 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN i.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%') OR #{location} LIKE CONCAT('%', i.location, '%') THEN 30 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(i.create_time, #{createTime})) <= 7 THEN 20 - ABS(DATEDIFF(i.create_time, #{createTime})) * 2 ELSE 0 END ) AS match_score FROM item i LEFT JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE i.type = #{matchType} AND i.status = 1 AND i.id != #{excludeId} HAVING match_score > 0 ORDER BY match_score DESC, i.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
